character_facts: Othon acts as the negotiator and uses his exclusive knowledge as leverage.
Bari is identified by Othon as sharing the secret of the Epiphyte.
The imperial couple hold authority and conduct the negotiation from a position of power.
The Endoguard is depicted as an elite armed escort accompanying the imperial party.
continuity_links: This page follows an earlier event by explicitly stating that a week has passed.
The negotiation continues an existing conflict over control of or access to the Epiphyte.
Othon and Bari remain allied at this stage and present a united front before the empire.
dialogue_meaning: The narration establishes a one-week time jump and the arrival of the imperial party at Marmola.
The page says Othon and Bari are honored before the negotiation.
Othon claims that he and Bari alone possess the knowledge needed to locate the Epiphyte.
He warns that coercion would not produce the secret efficiently and that searching without them would take years.
The imperial side wants a deal quickly and demands that Othon name his conditions.
locations: a large industrial or urban installation at Marmola
lore_facts: The imperial couple travel in a distinctive golden vessel.
A purple Endoguard is presented as part of the imperial entourage.
Marmola is important enough to host the imperial couple and negotiations over the Epiphyte.
The Epiphyte is a secret whose location or access method is known only to Othon and Bari on this page.
Finding the Epiphyte without Othon and Bari would, according to Othon, take years on Marmola because the planet is immense.
The empire urgently wants an agreement concerning the Epiphyte.
plot_events: One week after the prior scene, the imperial couple travel to Marmola in their golden vessel.
A new purple Endoguard accompanies the imperial party.
Othon and Bari arrive and are publicly congratulated and rewarded.
The meeting moves into a private chamber for negotiations.
Othon tells the imperial couple that only he and his son know the secret of the Epiphyte and that torture alone will not reveal it quickly.
The imperial side presses Othon to state his terms for an agreement.

visual_summary: A narration box states that one week later the imperial couple's golden vessel arrives at Marmola with a new purple Endoguard. The page shows the gold ship approaching a vast mechanical city or installation, then Baron Othon and his son Bari being received inside a monumental chamber by robed imperial figures and armored guards. In a private audience, Othon kneels or bows before the imperial couple, and then sits facing them while negotiations begin over the secret location of the Epiphyte.
